review_comments.body:
Is it worth reusing the `isNaN` check from `doGenerate` here? An invalid timestamp string gives the consumer an `Invalid Date`, and then the AI SDK can't fall back to its own value.

Applied in #485.

This part goes out whenever `response` exists. For OpenAI that's every call, because of `headers`, even when `id`, `modelId` and `timestamp` are all `undefined`. Is it worth sending it only when one of them is set? It's replay-safe as is, since `streamText` merges with `??`. It's only extra noise for code that counts parts.

Did this in #485.

Not from this PR, but it's close by. Error parts are often plain objects, so the failure message below reads `[object Object]`. Could we use `getErrorMessage` from `@ai-sdk/provider-utils` when we build it?

Done in #466.
